component.name: Kichi
component.summary: PikPak 的非官方桌面客户端

description.p: Kichi is an unofficial PikPak client for KDE Plasma, built with Rust and Qt 6. It focuses on native desktop integration, resumable transfers and an embedded libmpv player.
Kichi 是面向 KDE Plasma 的 PikPak 非官方桌面客户端，使用 Rust 和 Qt 6 编写，重点是原生桌面体验、可续传的传输任务和内嵌 libmpv 播放。

ul.li: Browse, search and manage cloud files
Offline tasks, downloads with resume, uploads and shares
Embedded libmpv playback, subtitles and resume
云盘浏览与搜索、离线任务、断点下载、上传与分享
内嵌 libmpv 播放、外挂字幕与续播
